title: In the cloud, the precompact handoff hook leaves the handoff stale
why: Measured by the retrospective: at 21:04 CST Nov 12 its handoff was about 2 hours behind on CI and merges, after a hook-prompted rewrite. Owner 21:11 CST: the pre-compact hooks "rnt running well in the cloud".
note: Find the cause: whether the PreCompact hook fires in the cloud at all, whether the checkpoint fires before the cloud's 384k trigger (steps handoff-checkpoint-before-cloud-compact and handoff-checkpoint-before-compact are done, so this may be a regression), and whether the post-compaction rewrite draws on a stale digest. Red first on a cloud fixture. Triage sighting 21:16 CST: in this session after the 21:00 compaction, the state line was current but the push times it carried were written from memory (stamp-guard-bracket-form). Handoff-audit-after-compact is the backstop, not the fix.
